subject.title: [Feature]: Advertise real-time voice provider voices (and models) in talk.catalog

question: Should the public realtime voice provider contract standardize optional flat `voices` and `models` pick-lists now, or require model-scoped or dynamic discovery before extending the SDK?
rationale: This adds a permanent plugin SDK capability whose semantics affect external provider plugins and future clients; source inspection establishes the gap but cannot choose the long-term metadata model.

options.title: Approve flat optional lists
options.body: Add optional provider-wide voices and project existing models uniformly, omitting empty lists and leaving richer model-scoped discovery as a future additive extension.

options.title: Design model-scoped discovery first
options.body: Pause the linked PR and define a per-model map or dynamic discovery hook before exposing realtime voices to clients.

recommendation.title: Approve flat optional lists
recommendation.body: Add optional provider-wide voices and project existing models uniformly, omitting empty lists and leaving richer model-scoped discovery as a future additive extension.

likelyOwner.reason: The realtime provider plugin boundary and central SDK contract appear to originate from and remain closely associated with this history.
